method_note: REPRODUCIBLE audit of the frozen machine issue #31 forecast for completed W43 against final Master Monday and 168 observed UTC hours. All 12 required IDs are scored in supplied order using SUPPORTED=100, MIXED=50, CONTRADICTED=0 and NOT_EVALUABLE=null. Price Ranges retain the eight-envelope precision rule: both observed extrema must fit each frozen BTC/ETH weekly or day-window band. All eight fit, yielding 100%. The five structural-call rows average 90% for an internal parameter audit only; Market / Structure has no public accuracy percentage. The nonspecific Day 5–7 two-branch description receives partial descriptive credit, not directional skill credit. Public continuity is the equal-weight mean of all 12 parameter scores, 1,100/12=91.67%; it is not investment performance. The ETH/BTC condition did not freeze a weekly-close direction, so its score credits only the qualitative absence of confirmed stabilization. The prior 2–3-week outlook has not fully matured. Decision utility is unavailable without an execution outcome or supported rubric. The supplied prospective bridge targets W39, not W43 or W44.
misses: The prior mixed outlook underweighted the failed early rebound: BTC, ETH and ETH/BTC all finished W43 below their weekly opens.
The Day 5–7 map allowed both branches without identifying the realized late-week decline; it receives only partial descriptive credit.
Individual capitalization-tier handoffs were not measured independently, limiting credit for the full-ladder call.
